name: Serenissima
source:
As a newly Embraced fledgling - and a Caitiff on top of that - you have a hard path in front of you. 
Being also a secret agent of the local Second Inquisition doesn't help.
Luckily you are - or you were? - their best detective, and you have no intention of letting your old comrades down right before the beginning of the war. Or at least this is what you think at first. Once you get to know what Kindred society is really about and some of its inhabitans, you're going to question everything you used to believe in...

[From [url=https://unseelieaurora.itch.io/serenissima]Itch.io[/url]]

This game is a parody of Vampire: The Masquerade.
translation:
作为一个新拥抱的雏鸟 - 以及除此之外的Caitiff - 你面前有一条艰难的道路。 
身为当地第二宗教裁判所的特工也无济于事。
幸运的是你是——或者你曾经是？- 他们最好的侦探，你不想在战争开始前让你的老战友失望。或者至少你一开始是这么想的。一旦你了解了亲属社会的真正含义以及它的一些居民，你就会质疑你曾经相信的一切……

[来自[url=https://unseelieaurora.itch.io/serenissima]Itch.io[/url]]

该游戏是对《吸血鬼：假面舞会》的模仿。
